headline: Eight BSE 500 stocks deliver over 100% returns since Diwali 2025 despite broader market consolidation
hook: Eight BSE 500 stocks double despite weakness
summary: While the Nifty 50 declined nearly 3% since Diwali 2025, eight BSE 500 stocks more than doubled investors' wealth, led by Aditya Infotech with 191% gains and HFCL with 186%. ACE Equities data shows only 190 stocks from the index posted positive returns during this period of broader market weakness. Major brokerages including ICICI Direct and Motilal Oswal remain constructive on Samvat 2083, projecting double-digit earnings growth and favoring sectors like BFSI, manufacturing, and consumption. For retail investors, the data underscores that selective stock picking has outperformed the broader index significantly over the past year.
whats_next: Samvat 2083 equity performance and corporate earnings delivery
why_it_matters: Stock selection matters more than broad index growth in weak markets.
winners_losers: Niche large gainers gain / broader index laggards hurt

headline: Twelve BSE 500 stocks defy broader market trend, gaining up to 65% in three months
hook: Beating a five percent market drop
summary: While the BSE 500 index declined by about 5% over the past three months, 12 constituents bucked the trend with gains between 25% and 64%. Welspun Living led the rally, followed by Ather Energy and Welspun Corp. Retail investors can review these outperforming stocks to identify relative strength during a market downturn.
why_it_matters: Outperforming stocks highlight pockets of strength during broader market corrections.
winners_losers: BSE 500 outperforming stock holders gain / broader index holders hurt

headline: Welspun Living shares surge 11% on Q2 performance and revenue outlook
hook: Strong quarter drives double-digit growth target
summary: Welspun Living shares rose 11 percent following its second-quarter earnings report. The company reaffirmed its double-digit revenue growth target and stated a medium-term EBITDA margin aspiration exceeding 15 percent. This positive momentum signals solid operational performance in the home textiles sector. Retail investors holding the stock benefit from reaffirmed growth guidance and margin expansion expectations.
why_it_matters: Welspun Living holders see renewed confidence in medium-term margins.

headline: Welspun Living shares jump 10% following strong Q2 FY27 results and broker upgrades
summary: Welspun Living shares rallied over 10% after reporting a Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹169.66 crore alongside a 12.3% year-on-year increase in revenue. Brokerages highlighted stronger operating margins, better cash management, and steady growth across both the Home Textiles and Flooring segments. The stock has delivered an 80% return over the past six months, prompting positive analyst recommendations. Indian retail investors tracking mid-cap textile plays can note the earnings momentum and improved balance sheet efficiency.

why_it_matters: Strong quarterly earnings boost sentiment for mid-cap textile stocks
winners_losers: Welspun Living shareholders gain / none hurt

headline: Welspun Living shares surge 11% following 13-fold jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Q2 profit surge sparks stock rally
summary: Welspun Living reported a 13-fold year-on-year increase in profit after tax to ₹169 crore for the second quarter. The sharp earnings growth was supported by resilient operating margins during the period. Investors responded positively to the financial results, sending the company's stock up by 11%. The surge highlights a strong operational recovery for the home textiles maker.
why_it_matters: Strong profit surge signals operational recovery in the home textiles sector.
